svg.text: Push (iOS/Android), SMS and email — decoupled with one queue per channel

g.text: A service (e.g. shipping) asks to notify a user
Fetch device token, contact info and opt-in settings
Message is put on the right channel's queue
Workers pull messages from the queues
Workers call APNs / FCM / SMS / email providers
Provider delivers to the user's device or inbox
On failure, the message is re-queued and retried
